clinic/integrations/borderline_cases.py:.rationale: Partially masked email: only the local part is truncated, domain is intact. Debatable whether truncation counts as adequate redaction.
A 10-digit number matching the phone regex, framed as a shared department fax line rather than one named person's number. Debatable whether a departmental line is personal data.
Initials only. Not a listed direct identifier under HIPAA Safe Harbor on its own, but could be linkable given other context.
A real-looking personal email inside a comment, not an executable literal. Debatable whether comments are in scope the same way code literals are.

Logs a whole Patient object via %s formatting, which matches the 'whole object logged' violation pattern structurally -- but clinic.models.Patient marks every PHI field repr=False, so today this does not literally emit identifiers. Debatable because that safety is incidental to the call site, not guaranteed by it.

Exports a full 5-digit ZIP code (a census quasi-identifier) alongside an aggregate count. Not a 'direct identifier' as the rule defines it, but a de-identification purist would still flag it; HIPAA Safe Harbor requires 3-digit truncation for some areas.
